title: Libya: Examination of Intervention and UK Foreign Policy, the Ninth Report of Session 2016-17
authors: House of Commons Foreign Affairs Committee
publisher_or_archive: United Kingdom Parliament / House of Commons HC 119
summary: Authoritative bipartisan parliamentary investigation concluding that the 2011 NATO intervention in Libya was executed without accurate intelligence, was opportunistically transformed from civilian protection into an unprincipled regime change campaign, and directly precipitated state collapse, armed militia fragmentation, migrant exploitation, and the catastrophic growth of ISIS in North Africa.
